newsitem.title: UK: Copper backwardation flares in hectic LME ring.
newsitem.headline: Copper backwardation flares in hectic LME ring.

text.p: COPPER - Heavy cash buying and borrowing pushed out cash/threes backwardation to $205/$215. Cash/day at $19, cash/week $70.
Three months low key but firmer at $2,308, underpinned by spread. Expectation of tightness persisting.
ALUMINIUM - Touch firmer, absorbs pricing sales.
ZINC - Still holding below $1,500. September tightness reflected by Sept/threes $16/$18 backwardation.
